significance: A shrine near Kherva in Mehsana district to Sadhimata, kuldevi of the Raval Yogi community, built by a former pujari, Khodabhai Raval, and served by his descendants. Its rectangular-domed sanctum stands under a large neem tree with courtyards for the annual Dharo Atham No Melo fair on Bhadrva Sud Aatham.
